celina.name: ACI International Rally
celina.blurb: 71st Airstream Club International Rally, June 24–29, 2028, Mercer County Fairgrounds. ACI assigns rally parking.
activities: Rally seminars, caravan and club meetups
Grand Lake St. Marys, a few minutes from the fairgrounds
Airstream factory in Jackson Center (about 35 mi) — check whether rally-week factory tours are offered

campgrounds.name: Mercer County Fairgrounds (rally parking)
campgrounds.notes: Assigned through rally registration; confirm early-arrival date.

niagara.name: Niagara Falls
niagara.blurb: Canadian side only — best views of Horseshoe Falls.
activities: Boat ride into the Horseshoe Falls basin (Niagara City Cruises, Canadian side)
Niagara Parkway drive to Niagara-on-the-Lake — wineries, old town, Shaw Festival
WEGO bus instead of parking the truck at the falls

campgrounds.name: Niagara Falls KOA Holiday
campgrounds.notes: Lundy's Lane area; check shuttle access to the falls.

thousand.name: Thousand Islands
thousand.blurb: St. Lawrence islands; Kingston is 30 minutes west.
activities: Island boat cruise from Gananoque or Rockport
Boldt Castle (Heart Island, US side — passport needed from the Canadian boats)
Fort Henry National Historic Site, Kingston

montreal.name: Montréal
montreal.blurb: Option B only. Camp south of the island and go in by truck or transit.

quebec.name: Québec City
quebec.blurb: Walled old city on the St. Lawrence.
activities: Old Québec — walls, Château Frontenac, Dufferin Terrace

campgrounds.name: KOA Québec City (Saint-Nicolas, south shore)
campgrounds.notes: South shore; the Lévis ferry is an option into the old city.

campgrounds.name: Camping de la Joie (Charlesbourg)
campgrounds.notes: North shore, closer to Montmorency Falls.

edmundston.name: Edmundston (overnight)
edmundston.blurb: One-night break on the long Québec-to-Fundy run.

fundy.name: Fundy National Park
fundy.blurb: World's highest tides. Plan activities around the tide table.
activities: Hopewell Rocks — walk the ocean floor at low tide, come back at high tide

campgrounds.name: Headquarters Campground (Parks Canada)
campgrounds.notes: Serviced sites. The booking system matches sites to trailer length.

pei.name: Prince Edward Island
pei.blurb: In over the Confederation Bridge, out on the Wood Islands ferry — no backtracking, and the bridge toll is paid only on leaving.
activities: PEI National Park beaches and dunes

campgrounds.name: Cavendish Campground (PEI National Park)
campgrounds.notes: The booking system matches sites to trailer length. Second candidate still needed — PEI's only KOA is at Borden, by the bridge.

capebreton.name: Cape Breton
capebreton.blurb: Base camp for the Cabot Trail. Leave the trailers; drive it in the trucks.
activities: Skyline Trail, Cape Breton Highlands NP
Alexander Graham Bell National Historic Site, Baddeck

campgrounds.name: Baddeck Cabot Trail Campground
campgrounds.notes: Central base for the full loop.

campgrounds.name: Broad Cove Campground (Cape Breton Highlands NP)
campgrounds.notes: On the trail itself, near Ingonish.

halifax.name: Halifax & South Shore
activities: Lunenburg (UNESCO old town) and Mahone Bay

campgrounds.name: Graves Island Provincial Park (Chester)
campgrounds.notes: South Shore alternative, closer to Lunenburg and Peggy's Cove.

saintjohn.name: Saint John (overnight)
saintjohn.blurb: Splits the Halifax-to-Acadia run; the St. Stephen–Calais border comes next morning.

acadia.name: Acadia National Park
acadia.blurb: Park the rigs and ride the free Island Explorer shuttle — the Park Loop Road isn't for trailers.
activities: Park Loop Road on the Island Explorer shuttle
Cadillac Mountain sunrise (vehicle reservation on recreation.gov)
Jordan Pond House popovers; carriage roads
Bass Harbor Head Light; Schoodic Peninsula

campgrounds.name: Blackwoods Campground (NPS)
campgrounds.fit: 29 of 281 sites take trailers up to 35 ft

campgrounds.name: Seawall Campground (NPS)
campgrounds.notes: Quiet side of the island. No hookups at any site.
campgrounds.fit: 30 of 178 sites take trailers of 30–35 ft

campgrounds.name: Bar Harbor Campground
campgrounds.notes: Full-hookup RV sites; takes reservations. Confirm shuttle access.

whitemtns.name: White Mountains
whitemtns.blurb: Two nights in the notches before the run home.
activities: Mount Washington Cog Railway or Auto Road (truck only)

fingerlakes.name: Finger Lakes (overnight)
activities: Seneca Lake wineries; Watkins Glen gorge trail

campgrounds.name: Erie KOA Holiday
campgrounds.fit: Some site types capped at 25–28 ft; book a pull-thru
